name: Bastion Lunchbox Fixes
derivation: Exact-v13 Bastion runtime retained; v1.0.6 permanently incorporates the tested staged-write sequence for AV2 Lunch Boxes + 0% Side Skirts and moves runtime/compatibility identifiers and log names into DigitalKaizer-owned namespaces.

confirmed_v1_0_6_behavior.light_lunch_and_skirts: user-tested working only when Lunch Box armor is temporarily staged AV2->AV4 before skirt writes and restored AV4->AV2 afterward
confirmed_v1_0_6_behavior.diagnostic_conclusion: write sequencing confirmed as the cause of the direct light-box + skirt CTD; final AV2 + 0% skirt state is valid

staged_write_sequence: for light-box + skirts option only: temporarily write Lunch Box armor AV2->AV4
apply normal 0% Main-transfer actions including side skirts
restore staged Lunch Box armor to its pre-stage AV2 values

codex_module_bridge_v1_compatibility.behavior: If a real CodexModuleBridge global is already active, DigitalKaizer compatibility dispatch is skipped. Otherwise this mod conditionally requires the two known Bridge v1 gameplay modules if present.
codex_module_bridge_v1_compatibility.required_priority_when_present: Bastion Lunchbox Fix must win mods/codex/gun_calibration

variants.name: Light Lunch Boxes + Side Skirts 0% Main
